favourite.heading: Why Virginia can pull away
bullets: Playing at Virginia is worth 2.8 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+2.8 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Duke can keep it close
bullets: Duke is the better football team by 3.6 points on opponent-adjusted results, with roughly 35% of it still inherited from last season (-3.6 pts).
Run defense: Duke 58.1 (#43 of 138) vs Virginia 47.7 (#78 of 138) — 35 places on the national board.
QB room: Duke 61.0 (#24 of 138) vs Virginia 59.7 (#38 of 138) — 14 places on the national board.

The outcome range is 14.6 points wide at one sigma — p10 -20.5 to p90 +21.5 for Virginia, so a projection of +0.5 still produces results a long way either side of it.
